1_identity.item: identity: I in RUNS reproduces BASE bit for bit

2_vdp_gain.item: van der Pol gain: R ratio <= 0.90 at >= 3 of the 5 E (extrapolated E excluded)

3_no_regression.item: no regression: worst in-range R <= 1.06 and worst in-range C <= 1.10 on hires, robertson, brusselator-1d-50

4_rejections.item: rejections: pooled van der Pol rejection fraction of PREDcap <= 0.5 x I's

5_calibration.item: calibration: err(PREDcap)/rtol <= max(2.0, 1.5 err(I)/rtol) in every dense cell and seed

factorial_reading.question: does PREDcap beat I725 by >= 3 % in geometric-mean R on hires or brusselator-1d-50?
